audit.why: EVEN 6/10 kept, matching the mirror, which explicitly left diff and diffRating alone and fixed the chart instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, Level 2, Levels 4-5, Level 6 and 2+ items all disagreed with the packet chart and with this page's own whys.
audit.why: Packet chart is Nautilus / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill and the mirror moved row 0 to Nautilus and rows 3 and 4 to Illaoi. whys[0] says you out-trade her before a single tentacle exists, whys[1] calls Level 2 a coin-flip, whys[3] and whys[4] hand her the tentacle field and Leap of Faith, and whys[6] says the late game 'keeps it even'.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped as matched pairs; row 0 rating raised to 6/10 for the Nautilus row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The healing is credited to 'her W' in three places. Harsh Lesson is a leap that deals damage and makes tentacles swing — it does not heal.
audit.why: Riot text: Prophet of an Elder God is what heals Illaoi, and only when her Tentacles damage a champion. Harsh Lesson is a 4s dash carrying the autoReset flag, which makes it her burst tell. Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and carries the untargetable flag, so dumping your commit into it wastes it. Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s.
audit.corrected: whys[1], whys[3] and wants.foe[1] moved onto the tentacle heal; dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns carry the 16s, 4s and 120s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Nothing told the player what to wait for before committing.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now give 'engage after she spends the 16s Test of Spirit', and dontsFull[1].d gives 'wait out Leap of Faith'.
